dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-lateral flank, characterized by dark perimeters transitioning into lighter interior pixel values; one prominent 'C' arc is visible on the upper dorsal-midsection with a sharp gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily along the dorsal ridge and the posterior-lateral region; these clusters appear as solid bright spots without internal luminance gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the central lateral surface form an elongated obtuse triangle; a secondary group of centroids from high-intensity blobs creates a loose, irregular polygon near the caudal peduncle.
